title: Power Extension Cable 0T736H – (6FT, 250V, 13A, C13 to C14) High-Quality Cord for Servers & IT Equipment

items.h: Connector Type: IEC C13 to C14 (Male to Female)
Perfect for servers, networking gear, and power distribution units

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Power Cord Cable 0T736H (6FT, 250V, 13A, C13 to C14) is designed for efficient and safe power connectivity in data centers, server rooms, and professional IT environments.

This IEC 60320 C13 to C14 extension cable allows you to extend your power connection between devices like servers, power distribution units (PDUs), UPS systems, and monitors.


Manufactured with premium materials, it ensures stable power flow and long-lasting durability.


Key Features:


  • Model: 0T736H
  • Connector Type: IEC C13 to C14 (Male to Female)
  • Cable Length: 6 Feet (1.8 Meters)
  • Voltage Rating: 250 Volts
  • Current Rating: 13 Amps
  • Color: Black
  • Perfect for servers, networking gear, and power distribution units
  • Durable and flexible cable for secure connection


Applications:

Ideal for extending power connections in server racks, data centers, offices, and home setups where C13 to C14 connections are used.
